slice: RPP-5ms consumed MLINE append counts 129 through 173 and count-174 refusal
scope: Qualifies runtime-generated AC1027 one-element consumed-style append profiles from source counts 129 through 173, producing target counts 130 through 174. Separately binds the source-count 174 to 175 fail-closed refusal under the adapter's 64 MiB conservative retained-byte budget. No broader support claim is promoted.

contract.positiveAdmission: Each source count 129..173 is generated with the shared ordered offset, ACI and alternating ByLayer/Continuous tuple recipe. One tuple is appended. Source/target flags are 2 with unchanged angles; two source-bound open, uncut and unfilled MLINE consumers use each style.
contract.geometryAndOutput: Source group-41 pairs are checked against the source minimum and all consumer pairs are recalculated against the target minimum. Exact target group-71 and group-73 counts, ordered style tuples, group-340 style identity and group-74/group-41/group-75 arrays are inspected in actual output. Fresh import checks tuples and consumer data in model space and a named block.
contract.positiveFailureAndRetry: For each positive count, four source/output encoding combinations and eight readbacks pass. Unsupported flags and a late live-consumer mutation each refuse before publication with destination/caller checks; corrected state retries successfully on the same adapter in ASCII and binary output.
contract.resourceBoundary: The generated source count 174 with one appended element to target 175 is refused in both ASCII and binary output. Four attempts preserve the sentinel destination and caller snapshot; repeat attempts on the same adapter also refuse cleanly. A temporary source diagnostic isolated the failing admission: the accumulated conservative charge was 65,160,640 bytes before charging an estimated 34,775-byte typed MLINE entity. The named-resource accounting multiplies that estimate by 64, requiring another 2,225,600 bytes; projected total 67,386,240 exceeds the 64 MiB limit (67,108,864) by 277,376 bytes. The append-projection estimate itself fits. The temporary diagnostic was removed; the retained-byte cap was not changed.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. All DXFs are generated at runtime and removed after success; no fixture files are committed.
contract.limits: Positive evidence is limited to counts 129..173 and the exact generated AC1027 tuple/consumer profile. Count 174→175 is a qualified fail-closed resource refusal, not append support. Counts 175..254, other append cardinalities, removals, schema/carrier/version variants and native/document semantics remain unqualified. The earlier 254→255 attempt remains a separate unexplained refusal.

controls.boundaryRollbackRetry: Two output-format refusals, each repeated on the same adapter; sentinel destination and caller snapshot preserved on all four attempts.

focusedTests.combinedSummary: The 129..173 range passed 180 source/output combinations and 360 readbacks, with 90 unsupported-flag and 90 late-mutation refusals plus 180 corrected retries. The count-174 boundary control passed four expected refusals and two same-adapter retry checks.
